title: Delivery
intro: Delivery helps managers track outbound orders on a map, manage delivery areas, and configure delivery settings.

sections.title: Delivery hub
steps: Tabs at the top switch between Delivery orders, Areas, and Settings.
The Delivery tab shows a map and a list of active delivery orders.
sections.caption: Delivery screen with tabs.

sections.title: Map and order list
steps: The map shows delivery zones and order markers when coordinates exist.
Click a marker or list row to open the order popup.
When no delivery orders are open, the list shows an empty state.
sections.caption: Delivery map and order sidebar.

sections.title: Delivery areas
sections.intro: Define geographic zones used for delivery routing and reporting.
steps: Draw or manage polygons on the map for each delivery zone.
Save area changes when your role allows editing.
sections.caption: Delivery areas tab.

sections.title: Delivery settings
steps: Configure map center, fees, and other delivery options for the venue.
Save when finished (manager approval may be required).
sections.caption: Delivery settings tab.
